desc.zh: 先验证一个和的上限，再二分寻找最小可行上限。
desc.en: Test a sum cap with a greedy scan, then search for the smallest feasible cap.

complexity: O(n log(S - M + 2)) time; O(1) auxiliary space, S=sum(nums), M=max(nums)

concepts.name: Binary search on a feasible cap
concepts.description: Keep the smallest feasible cap in an inclusive interval.

concepts.name: Greedy contiguous partition
concepts.description: A maximal prefix under a nonnegative sum cap minimizes group count.
